result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both are nearly the same wide landscape layout with three bands (title, hours card plus flu card, and a check-in banner), strong contrast and no mobile features. A's weak spots are that 'Monday – Friday' wraps awkwardly and its small 'Today' line can't be read from across a room. B's clinic name is larger and its white card contrasts more, but its 'Mon – Fri TODAY' label wraps clumsily too. Both add a small lift/stairs instruction that the request didn't ask for. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both boards use the same wide layout: a large header, two side-by-side cards and a full-width check-in banner. Everything fits on one screen and no mobile features were added. In A, the white and light-green cards give stronger contrast, but 'Mon – Fri TODAY' wraps awkwardly. In B, 'Monday – Friday' also wraps, the light-blue secondary text and small 'Today' line are dimmer, and its larger flu-clinic headline makes up for that, so they come out roughly even.
